method.notes: Elias Morad provides a tested chef precedent for an oil-based vegan roti, a 30-minute first rest and at least 4 hours after balling. This home adaptation uses 52% hydration by weight and 15 g oil allocated to dough, coating, stretching and cooking, 5 + 4 + 4 + 2 g. The dhal uses Tony Tan's coconut-milk method and Morad's red lentils and tomato; tomato is added once the lentils soften. Exact weights match the checked-in Fineli and AFCD rows. Two rotis and two servings of dhal. Full measured oil retention is an upper estimate. No physical trial.

food_safety.notes: Simmer split red lentils until soft before adding tomatoes, cook the roti through and serve the dhal hot. Check the curry powder for allergens.

servings_and_time.notes: 2 portions with 310 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
